senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; סָפַר)scribe, writer of documents, copyist of prayers &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 8:8">Gitt. VIII, 8</cite> <he>כתב ס׳ גט וכ׳</he> if the scribe wrote the letter of divorce for the husband and a receipt for the wife &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 51a:14">Keth. 51ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>טעות ס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A01052"><he>אַחֲרָיוּת</he></cite>.

B. Bath. 21ᵇ ס׳ מתא (Ms. M. ספר) town-scribe (libellarius); B. Mets. 109ᵇ top ספר; B. Bath. 21ᵃ ס׳ מתא (some ed. ספר), v. Tosaf. a. l.; (Rashi: principal of a town-school keeping assistants, v. infra); a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 45b:15">Ber. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>אחד ס׳ וכ׳</he> if one is a scholar (knowing the prayers) and the other illiterate.

senses.gloss: school teacher, primary teacher. B. Bath. l. c. ס׳ יהודי a Jewish teacher; ס׳ ארמאי a teacher of secular branches (oth. opin.: a gentile teacher). Ib. ס׳ מתא, v. supra. Tosef. Meg. IV (III), 38 והס׳ מלמד כדרכו but the Bible teacher teaches (these passages) in his usual way; a. fr.—Pl. סוֹפְרִים, סוֹפְרִין.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:7:3">Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ</cite>, a. e. <he>ס׳ ומשנים</he>, v. <cite ref="M02946"><he>מִשְׁנִים</he></cite>. Ber. l. c. <he>בששניהם ס׳</he> when both of them are scholarly men (knowing the prayers); a. fr.—

Kidd. IV, 13 לא יְלַמֵּד ס׳ must not be a teacher of primary schools.—מסכת ס׳ the Treatise Sof’rim, one of the small treatises attached to the Talmud, containing rules for writing Torah copies; (in Septem Libri &c., ed. Kirchheim: מסכת ספר תורה).—Esp. Sofer, pl. Sof’rim, title of the scholars of the ante-Tannaic period, beginning with Ezra (v.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:5">Y. Shek. V, beg. 48ᶜ</cite>.

Kidd. 30ᵃ לפיכך … ס׳ שהיו סופרים וכ׳ the early scholars were called Sof’rim, because they counted all the letters in the Torah; a. fr.—דברי ס׳ enactments or interpretations dating from the Soferic period.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:4">Yeb. II, 4</cite> <he>מד׳ ס׳</he> belonging to the prohibitions ascribed to the Sof’rim.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:3">Snh. XI, 3</cite> <he>חומר בד׳ ס׳ וכ׳</he> disregard of Soferic enactments is more strictly dealt with &c., v. <cite ref="H00390"><he>חוֹמֶר</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 88b:18">Ib. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>דבר שעיקרו … מד׳ ס׳</he> a law which is founded on the Torah, but the interpretation of which dates from the Soferic period.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kiddushin 5:21">Tosef. Kidd. V, 21</cite>; a. fr.—<he>תקון ס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00488"><he>תִּיקּוּן</he></cite>.
